families.label: would be turned down by a conventional lender
families.formula: count of households with P(denial) > 50% on a 6.86% market loan for a $750k home
families.source: Gradient-boosted model trained on HMDA OC loan decisions, 2022-2023 (champion, AUC 0.779)

mortgages.label: expected to keep their homes for 10 years (market loans: 7.5)
mortgages.formula: sum over households of P(still own at year 10), 1,500 simulated decades each
mortgages.source: Monte Carlo of job loss, insurance shocks, repairs and arrears; hazard rates are labelled assumptions

capital.label: of philanthropy closes the gap for 30 homes (standard 0% loans: $6.8M)
capital.formula: sum over homes of max(0, cost + reserve - mortgage PV - down payment - CalHome - AHP)
capital.source: Cost, CalHome and AHP per home are labelled planning assumptions; notes valued at 5% present value

decade.label: expected still owning at year 10: Keystone vs market loans
decade.formula: expected counts as in the mortgages beat; the animation shows one simulated decade per household
decade.source: Same simulation, same shocks across the three regimes (common random numbers)
